end.summary:
Practised safe water storage using clean, covered containers and a ladle or tap.
Explored hidden germs and dissolved substances in clear-looking water.
Practised saving water by closing taps, using a bucket bath, reusing water for plants, and catching rainwater.
Sugar dissolving versus ice melting was mixed up once and corrected later (turns 15, 21–22).
end.parentNote: Pari practised keeping drinking water in clean, covered containers and using a ladle instead of hands. They explained several ways to save water, including closing taps, using a bucket bath, and collecting rainwater; repeating the ideas and giving reasons supported their answers. There was an early mix-up between dissolving and melting, and it was corrected later by explaining that sugar remains in the water while ice changes from solid to liquid. At home, ask Pari to name one safe storage step and one water-saving step during daily routines.
